business_problem: As a leader in luxury automotive innovation, BMW Group needed to move from manual data transfers and on-premises servers to a faster, more scalable way to process vehicle development data.
solution_summary: BMW Group modernized its analytics estate on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Databricks, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Operational, enterprise, or sensor data is ingested into a shared cloud store and transformed with Azure engineering services so teams can work from one current source of truth. Fabric and related services unify streaming, lake, warehouse, and BI capabilities so analysts and frontline teams can query fresher data without stitching together separate products. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. As a leader in luxury automotive innovation, BMW Group needed to move from manual data transfers and on-premises servers to a faster, more scalable way to process vehicle development data.
